Cost ¥0." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="165" width="1300" x="40" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a1" parent="tA" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[R02] Cross-brand fleet orchestration
Open-RMF over Geek+ / Quicktron / HAI / Pudu

⭐ MOST DEFENSIBLE — Gartner: &gt;40% of enterprises
need cross-brand scheduling by 2026, and NO retail
Open-RMF integration exists in the public record" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="300" x="20" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a2" parent="tA" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[R03] Last-mile robot &amp; drone dispatch
Neolix / Zelos / Keeta, into order-service

⭐ cheapest real win. Neolix: 17,000 vehicles,
RaaS subscription — we integrate, never buy.
Model the HYBRID handoff, like Meituan does." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="300" x="340" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a3" parent="tA" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[R09] 智能货柜 unmanned retail as a channel

A cabinet is a store with no staff — model it as a
location + channel and I01/I02/I03/I08/C10 all apply.
40 facings = the most constrained assortment
problem in retail." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="300" x="660" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a4" parent="tA" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[R10] Robot fleet safety &amp; incident governance

⭐ the differentiator. Extends I06's ai_decision.
Zones as reviewable data · near-miss as a
first-class type · pre-flight zone gate, fail closed.
Build it WITH R02, not after." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="300" x="980" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tB" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="TIER B — simulation only, prove it before buying. Cost ¥0." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="145" width="1300" x="40" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1" parent="tB" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="[R06] Digital twin — simulate the store before buying anything ⭐ DO THIS FIRST

Gazebo Harmonic (not Isaac Sim — we need layout and traffic, not photorealism, and we have no NVIDIA GPU).
Replay REAL event streams — planogram changes, gap events, order picks — so the answer is
"three robots, to keep 95th-percentile task latency under 20 minutes on the week of 双11", not a guess.
The traffic_editor map artefact is SHARED with production R02 — that is what makes it a twin, not a model that drifts." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="1260" x="20" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tC" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;fontColor=#8a6d1e;" value="TIER C — one robot, rented or borrowed, for the demo. Cost: low thousands $." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="145" width="1300" x="40" y="450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c1" parent="tC" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="[R01] Shelf-scanning robot — the robot is a CAMERA ON WHEELS ⭐ best demo

Perception is already planned: C05 PP-ShiTuV2 (which SKU) + V04 RT-DETRv2 (is there a gap) + I03 (which SKU should be here).
R01 adds mobility and nothing else — which is why it is only ~3 weeks on top of C05.
Sleeper feature: PROMOTION-ERROR detection (shelf label vs price-service). Simbe's headline is 80M promotion errors fixed, not gaps found." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="880" x="20" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2" parent="tC" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[R05] In-store service robot
a kiosk that moves

C07 agent + V09 UX on a Pudu/Keenon base.
Unlocks exactly ONE new thing: 跟我来 —
escort the customer to the bay.
Measure whether that converts. It may not." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="102" width="360" x="920" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tD" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#fdf3f3;strokeColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;fontColor=#8a3a36;" value="TIER D — needs real fleet investment ($500k–$5M). Document, don't build." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="165" width="1300" x="40" y="615" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d1" parent="tD" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[R04] 前置仓 goods-to-person picking

Vendor RMS schedules AMRs (Geek+ does 5,000
in one warehouse). We own SLOTTING and
ORDER RELEASE — which work with or without robots.
Ship the tier-A/B subset + the capital business case." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="410" x="20" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d2" parent="tD" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[R07] RFID + robot inventory, fused with vision

Economic gate first: tags pay in apparel and
electronics, NOT in grocery FMCG.
The case only fusion finds: system 12 / RFID 12 /
visible 4 → REPLENISH the facing, not reorder." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="410" x="450" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d3" parent="tD" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[R08] Embodied-AI replenishment arm (VLA)
⚠ ROADMAP ONLY

Chinese humanoid output +94% in 2026, Unitree +
AgiBot ≈80% of shipments — but EVERY verified
deployment is manufacturing/logistics. Retail store
work is not a deployed use case. Do the licence audit." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="400" x="880" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mkt" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f9f9f9;strokeColor=#999999;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;" value="The strategic read — three facts from the research, put together" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="1300" x="40" y="800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m1" parent="mkt" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="1 · HARDWARE IS A COMMODITY

Top 5 commercial service robot firms
worldwide are ALL Chinese, together
&gt;half the global market, at 40–60%
below Western prices.
Geek+: ~56,000 AMRs, 800+ customers." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="410" x="20" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m2" parent="mkt" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="2 · THE VENDORS SAY THE MOAT IS SOFTWARE

Geek+'s edge is its RMS scheduler —
5,000 AMRs in ONE warehouse — and in
Feb 2026 it launched "Geek+ Brain",
explicitly a shift from MOBILITY to
OPERATION." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="410" x="450" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m3" parent="mkt" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="3 · CROSS-BRAND IS THE GAP

Gartner: by 2026 &gt;40% of enterprises
require cross-brand scheduling, and the
selection criterion moved from DEVICE
PERFORMANCE to SYSTEM CAPABILITY.

→ Nobody should build a robot. R02." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="400" x="880" y="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stack" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=36;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="The layer cake — our contribution is the top two boxes" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="500" x="1380" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l1" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="APPLICATION
stock · order · purchase · channel · ai-service" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="460" x="20" y="46" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l2" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="FLEET — Open-RMF (Apache-2.0, Intrinsic + OSRF)
multi-vendor traffic · tasks · lifts · doors
Mutex Groups = "air traffic control principles"" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="66" width="460" x="20" y="106" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l3" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;" value="NAVIGATION — Nav2
one robot, A → B, obstacle avoidance" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="460" x="20" y="182" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l4" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;" value="LOCALISATION — Cartographer / AMCL (2D, the retail answer)
FAST-LIO2 / LIO-SAM only for ramps and mezzanines
⚠ LIO-SAM needs per-point timestamp + ring fields" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="66" width="460" x="20" y="242" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l5" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;" value="MIDDLEWARE — ROS 2 Humble / Jazzy
(or AimRT — AgiBot's ROS-compatible runtime ⚠ licence unverified)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="460" x="20" y="318" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l6" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="HARDWARE — Geek+ · Quicktron · HAI · Pudu · Keenon
Neolix · Zelos · Unitree
← we buy or rent. We NEVER build." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="66" width="460" x="20" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sim" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="SIMULATION — pick by the question you have

Gazebo Harmonic ROS 2-native, layout + traffic ← OUR CHOICE
Isaac Sim / Lab digital twin + synthetic perception ⚠ needs NVIDIA GPU
MuJoCo / MJX contact-rich manipulation, VLA eval
Genie Sim 3.0 AgiBot, Isaac-integrated, Sim2Real zero-shot
 ⚠ MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft), parts multi-licensed
O3DE Apache-2.0 + MIT, no NVIDIA lock-in

⚠ "Gazebo worlds aren't always accurate representations of reality" —
 so the twin answers NAVIGATION, TRAFFIC and CAPACITY questions,
 never perception accuracy." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="500" x="1380" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lic" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="⚠ LICENCE WARNING — the VLA section

"'Open source' is used loosely in this space, and several of
these releases use restricted or NON-COMMERCIAL licences
despite the label." Check the LICENSE file AND the HF model
card separately — WEIGHTS AND CODE ARE OFTEN LICENSED
DIFFERENTLY.

Same trap as IDM-VTON (CC BY-NC-SA) and InsightFace.
⚠ unverified: OpenVLA · RDT-1B · GR00T N1 · AgiBot World ·
 SmolVLA · π0 · AimRT
✅ clean: Open-RMF, Nav2, Gazebo, MuJoCo, O3DE (Apache/MIT),
 Unitree SDKs (BSD 3-Clause), Milvus (Apache-2.0, LF graduated)

The licence audit is 4 hours and should be done regardless." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="250" width="500" x="1380" y="850" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rec" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;fontStyle=1" value="Recommended: R06 → R02 → R03, with R10 underneath and R01 as the on-stage demo.
R06 costs nothing and de-risks everything · R02 is the defensible gap · R03 is the cheapest thing here that touches revenue · R10 is the question every retailer asks first." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="1300" x="40" y="1000" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="foot" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=11;fontColor=#666666;" value="Every claim in this diagram is sourced in 00-china-robotics-market.md. All eight sources for §6 unmanned retail trace to a single vendor press release — treat those figures as directional." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="1400" x="40" y="1110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="tA" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="tB" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="tB" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="tC" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="tC" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="tD" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="tA" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;fontSize=11;" target="stack" value="rising hardware cost and risk"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
[R06] Digital twin — simulate the store before buying anything ⭐ DO THIS FIRST
Gazebo Harmonic (not Isaac Sim — we need layout and traffic, not photorealism, and we have no NVIDIA GPU).
Replay REAL event streams — planogram changes, gap events, order picks — so the answer is
"three robots, to keep 95th-percentile task latency under 20 minutes on the week of 双11", not a guess.
The traffic_editor map artefact is SHARED with production R02 — that is what makes it a twin, not a model that drifts.

div.div:
[R01] Shelf-scanning robot — the robot is a CAMERA ON WHEELS ⭐ best demo
Perception is already planned: C05 PP-ShiTuV2 (which SKU) + V04 RT-DETRv2 (is there a gap) + I03 (which SKU should be here).
R01 adds mobility and nothing else — which is why it is only ~3 weeks on top of C05.
Sleeper feature: PROMOTION-ERROR detection (shelf label vs price-service). Simbe's headline is 80M promotion errors fixed, not gaps found.

[R05] In-store service robot
a kiosk that moves
C07 agent + V09 UX on a Pudu/Keenon base.
Unlocks exactly ONE new thing: 跟我来 —
escort the customer to the bay.
Measure whether that converts. It may not.

div.div:
[R08] Embodied-AI replenishment arm (VLA)
⚠ ROADMAP ONLY
Chinese humanoid output +94% in 2026, Unitree +
AgiBot ≈80% of shipments — but EVERY verified
deployment is manufacturing/logistics. Retail store
work is not a deployed use case. Do the licence audit.

div.div:
1 · HARDWARE IS A COMMODITY
Top 5 commercial service robot firms
worldwide are ALL Chinese, together
>half the global market, at 40–60%
below Western prices.
Geek+: ~56,000 AMRs, 800+ customers.

div.div:
2 · THE VENDORS SAY THE MOAT IS SOFTWARE
Geek+'s edge is its RMS scheduler —
5,000 AMRs in ONE warehouse — and in
Feb 2026 it launched "Geek+ Brain",
explicitly a shift from MOBILITY to
OPERATION.

div.div:
3 · CROSS-BRAND IS THE GAP
Gartner: by 2026 >40% of enterprises
require cross-brand scheduling, and the
selection criterion moved from DEVICE
PERFORMANCE to SYSTEM CAPABILITY.
→ Nobody should build a robot. R02.

div.div:
SIMULATION — pick by the question you have
Gazebo Harmonic ROS 2-native, layout + traffic ← OUR CHOICE
Isaac Sim / Lab digital twin + synthetic perception ⚠ needs NVIDIA GPU
MuJoCo / MJX contact-rich manipulation, VLA eval
Genie Sim 3.0 AgiBot, Isaac-integrated, Sim2Real zero-shot
⚠ MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft), parts multi-licensed
O3DE Apache-2.0 + MIT, no NVIDIA lock-in
⚠ "Gazebo worlds aren't always accurate representations of reality" —
so the twin answers NAVIGATION, TRAFFIC and CAPACITY questions,
never perception accuracy.

div.div:
⚠ LICENCE WARNING — the VLA section
"'Open source' is used loosely in this space, and several of
these releases use restricted or NON-COMMERCIAL licences
despite the label." Check the LICENSE file AND the HF model
card separately — WEIGHTS AND CODE ARE OFTEN LICENSED
DIFFERENTLY.
Same trap as IDM-VTON (CC BY-NC-SA) and InsightFace.
⚠ unverified: OpenVLA · RDT-1B · GR00T N1 · AgiBot World ·
SmolVLA · π0 · AimRT
✅ clean: Open-RMF, Nav2, Gazebo, MuJoCo, O3DE (Apache/MIT),
Unitree SDKs (BSD 3-Clause), Milvus (Apache-2.0, LF graduated)
The licence audit is 4 hours and should be done regardless.

Recommended: R06 → R02 → R03, with R10 underneath and R01 as the on-stage demo.
R06 costs nothing and de-risks everything · R02 is the defensible gap · R03 is the cheapest thing here that touches revenue · R10 is the question every retailer asks first.
